name: youtube-clone
description: A YouTube clone built on Firebase Auth, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, and Next.js.

scripts.build: npm run build:contract && npm run build --workspace yt-web-client --workspace @yt/api-service --workspace video-processing-service
scripts.type-check: npm run build:contract && npm run type-check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
